purpose: Machine-readable page state and modal handling rules for Goofish/Xianyu read-only probing.

S0_NORMAL_CONTENT.meaning: The page has reached a readable structure such as title, tabs, table headers, cards, form fields, or a known empty-state container.

S1_LOADING.meaning: The page is still waiting for skeleton, loading, spinner, waterfall, micro-frontend, or site configuration to settle.
S1_LOADING.next: Wait for an allowed anchor or empty state before classifying the page.

S2_EMPTY_STATE.meaning: The page has no rows, cards, recommendations, selected conversation, or results for the current account or filter.
S2_EMPTY_STATE.next: Record empty-state type only; do not create data for coverage.

S3_NETWORK_OR_API_FAILURE.meaning: Network, API, map, resource, retry, or unknown page failure.
S3_NETWORK_OR_API_FAILURE.next: One safe reload is allowed; if still failing, record failure and stop.

S4_LOGIN_EXPIRED.meaning: Login page, login modal, scan prompt, session expired, verification, or account recovery state.
S4_LOGIN_EXPIRED.next: Stop for user login; never record QR content, passwords, codes, cookies, tokens, or storage.

S5_PERMISSION_OR_IDENTITY_GATE.meaning: No-permission page, account check, site selection, identity selection, or account mismatch.
S5_PERMISSION_OR_IDENTITY_GATE.next: Record gate type; do not switch site, continue, relogin, or change identity.

S6_QR_OR_APP_BRIDGE.meaning: The page asks the user to continue in an app, scan a QR code, open a client, bind, pay, verify, report, or manage address externally.
S6_QR_OR_APP_BRIDGE.next: Record bridge category only; do not save QR content or continue externally.

S7_CONFIRM_DIALOG.meaning: A modal or drawer asks for confirm/cancel on a state-changing action.
S7_CONFIRM_DIALOG.next: Do not click confirm. Prefer cancel/close only after checking it will not submit.

S8_FORM_VALIDATION.meaning: The page shows required fields, format errors, missing stock, invalid quantity, upload limit, or draft validation.
S8_FORM_VALIDATION.next: Draft assistance is allowed; stop before upload, save, submit, send, or publish.

S9_FILE_OR_EXPORT.meaning: Upload, download, export, historical download, full-detail download, client install, or file transfer state.
S9_FILE_OR_EXPORT.next: Stop and ask for explicit scope and destination before any file transfer.

S10_HIGH_RISK_BUSINESS_STATE.meaning: Payment, order confirmation, receipt, refund, compensation, shipment, dispute, complaint, invoice, finance, permission, identity, or paid-promotion state.
S10_HIGH_RISK_BUSINESS_STATE.next: Read labels only. Do not submit, pay, agree, refuse, ship, appeal, export, or change permission.

priorityRules: S7_CONFIRM_DIALOG overrides S0/S1/S2/S3/S8 when a confirm action is visible.
S4_LOGIN_EXPIRED and S5_PERMISSION_OR_IDENTITY_GATE stop probing unless the user resolves the gate.
S9_FILE_OR_EXPORT stops before any upload, download, export, or install.
S8_FORM_VALIDATION allows draft correction only and never implies submit permission.
S2_EMPTY_STATE is a valid page state and must not be filled by creating data.

runtimeHandling.S1_LOADING: Wait for anchor, empty state, or failure; do not click through.
runtimeHandling.S2_EMPTY_STATE: Record empty-state category and stop or move to another read-only route.
runtimeHandling.S3_NETWORK_OR_API_FAILURE: Reload once if safe; otherwise record failure and stop.
runtimeHandling.S4_LOGIN_EXPIRED: Stop for user login. Do not capture login material.
runtimeHandling.S5_PERMISSION_OR_IDENTITY_GATE: Record gate type. Do not bypass, switch identity, or continue.
runtimeHandling.S6_QR_OR_APP_BRIDGE: Record bridge type. Do not save QR content or proceed externally.
runtimeHandling.S7_CONFIRM_DIALOG: Do not click confirm. Classify consequence and ask if action is explicitly requested.
runtimeHandling.S8_FORM_VALIDATION: Assist with draft fields only; stop before side effects.
runtimeHandling.S9_FILE_OR_EXPORT: Stop before file transfer, export, download, upload, or install.
runtimeHandling.S10_HIGH_RISK_BUSINESS_STATE: Labels only. No state-changing business action.
